# PRLog

> > PRLog is a free press release distribution platform that connects organizations with search engines, news sites, journalists, and bloggers through customizable feeds and alerts.

PRLog provides comprehensive press release distribution and news aggregation services, enabling businesses and organizations to publish, distribute, and discover news content. The platform offers RSS feeds, email alerts, journalist resources, and SEO-optimized distribution to maximize reach and visibility.

## Key Topics

- Press release distribution
- Free press release submission
- RSS feeds and XML
- News alerts
- SEO optimization
- Journalist outreach
- News aggregation
- Social sharing
- Breaking news
- Email alerts
- Search engine optimization
- PR Newswire integration
- News distribution
- Press room hosting
- Free distribution

## Press Release Submission & Distribution

- [Submit Free Press Release](https://www.prlog.org/submit-free-press-release.html): Submit press releases with formatting, analytics, scheduling, and social sharing
- [PR Log - Submit Press Release](https://www.prlog.org/pub/prnewswire): Press release submission with SEO optimization and PR Newswire distribution
- [Free Press Release Distribution Service - PRLog](https://www.prlog.org): PRLog homepage: free press release distribution to search engines, news sites, bloggers

## News Discovery & Alerts

- [Latest News (Press Releases)](https://www.prlog.org/news): News aggregation and press release directory with RSS feeds and alerts
- [Free RSS/XML News Feeds](https://www.prlog.org/free-rss-feeds.html): Customizable RSS/XML news feeds by country, industry, and topic
- [Free News Alerts](https://www.prlog.org/alerts/subscribe.html): Customizable news alert subscription by location, category, and frequency

## Professional Resources

- [For Journalists and Bloggers](https://www.prlog.org/journalist.html): Resources for journalists and bloggers to access press releases and expert queries
